app.name: Karaoke Party
app.tagline: Everyone sings on their own phone, and the scores show up live.

home.signInToHost: Sign in to host a room. Friends can join without an account.
home.invalidCode: Room codes have 6 letters and numbers.
home.headline: Sing together, from any phone.
home.hostText: Create a room, then share the code or QR. Friends join without an account.
home.soloText: Practise any song on your own, beat your best score and listen back to yourself.
home.dailyText: One song for everyone today, one try each. How high can you get?

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.intro: We'll email you a link. No password needed.
signIn.sent: We sent a sign-in link to {{email}}. It works once and expires in 15 minutes.
signIn.devHint: Running locally? The email is in Mailpit: http://localhost:8025

lobby.confirmKick: Remove {{name}} from the room? They won't be able to rejoin.

ended.room_not_found: This room doesn't exist or has been closed.
ended.kicked: The host removed you from this room.
ended.replaced: This room is open in another tab or window.

profile.title: Profile
profile.name: Display name
profile.guestNote: You're playing as a guest. Sign in to host rooms and keep your name.

errors.account_required: You need an account for this. Guests can join rooms but not host them.
errors.room_not_found: We couldn't find that room. Check the code.
errors.too_many_links: Too many links requested. Wait a few minutes and try again.
errors.invalid_or_expired_link: This sign-in link has expired or was already used.
errors.not_allowed: Only the host can do that.

errors.unsupported_format: That file isn't a supported audio format (MP3, WAV, M4A or OGG).
errors.too_short: That audio is too short to be a song.
errors.rights_required: Please confirm you have the right to use this audio.
errors.conversion_limit_reached: You've used all your song conversions for this month.
errors.not_failed: This song didn't fail, so there's nothing to retry.
errors.track_not_found: That audio track doesn't exist for this song.
errors.chart_invalid_header: The chart has a header with an invalid number.

errors.chart_empty_line: The chart has an empty line.
errors.chart_invalid_note_timing: The chart has a note with an invalid start or length.
errors.chart_invalid_pitch: The chart has a note with an extreme pitch.
errors.chart_overlapping_notes: Some notes overlap. Fix them before saving.
errors.audio_decode_failed: We couldn't read this audio file.
errors.separation_failed: Separating the voice from the music failed.
errors.no_lyrics_found: We couldn't hear any singing in this song.

errors.wrong_phase: That's not possible while a song is playing.
errors.mic_denied: Microphone access was blocked. Allow it in your browser's site settings, then try again.
errors.mic_missing: No microphone was found on this device.
errors.mic_unsupported: This browser can't do live singing. Try a recent Chrome, Edge, Firefox or Safari.
errors.mic_insecure: The microphone only works on secure pages. Open the app at its https:// address (the one in the QR code).
errors.lyrics_lookup_failed: The lyrics search isn't working right now. Try again later, or paste the lyrics.
errors.lyrics_empty: There are no lyrics lines in that text.
errors.no_vocals_track: Only uploaded songs that were converted can get new lyrics.
errors.song_busy: This song is being worked on. Wait until it's ready.

errors.not_a_duet: Only duet songs can have a partner.

errors.already_played_today: You've already had your try today. Come back tomorrow!
errors.premium_required: That needs premium or a Party Pass for the host.
errors.replays_not_included: Group replays aren't included in this room's plan.
errors.code_not_found: That code doesn't exist. Check for typos.
errors.code_used_up: That code has been used up.
errors.no_party_pass: You have no Party Pass to start (or one is running already).
errors.no_such_account: There's no account with that email (guests can't get premium).
errors.unknown_error: Something went wrong. Please try again.

songs.title: Songs
songs.private: Only you can see your songs. When you host a room, the people in it can hear them.
songs.empty: You haven't added any songs yet.
songs.signInToUpload: Sign in to add your own songs.

steps.separating: Separating the voice from the music…
steps.matching: Lining the lyrics up with your file…
steps.aligning: Fitting the lyrics to the voice…

upload.title: Upload a song
upload.intro: We'll separate the voice from the music, write down the lyrics and find the melody. It takes a few minutes, and you can leave this page meanwhile.
upload.rights: I confirm I have the right to use this audio (for example, I recorded it or I have a licence for it).
upload.rightsNote: Only you can see your songs. When you host a room, the people in it can hear them.
upload.noConversionsLeft: You've used all {{total}} conversions for this month.

import.title: Import an UltraStar chart
import.intro: Already have an UltraStar chart (.txt) and its audio file? Import them here. This doesn't use up a conversion.

editor.title: Chart editor
editor.readOnly: This is a starter song: you can look, but not change it.
editor.gapHelp: Moves all the lyrics earlier or later. Use it when everything is out of sync with the music.
editor.noNote: Click a note to edit it.
editor.textHelp: Start with a space for a new word. "~" holds the previous syllable.
editor.help: Drag a note to move it, drag its right edge to change its length. Keys: ← → move, ↑ ↓ pitch, Shift + ← → length, Space play/pause, Ctrl+Z undo.

problems.empty_text: Line {{line}}: a note has no text.

mic.title: Your microphone
mic.robot: Test mode: a robot sings instead of your mic.

calibrate.title: Mic delay check
calibrate.intro: Phones add a small delay between your voice and the app. We measure it once so your timing is scored fairly.
calibrate.failed: We couldn't hear you clearly. Get closer to the mic and try again.

ready.needMic: Turn on your microphone to sing.

song.none: The host hasn't picked a song yet.

start.needReady: At least one player must be ready.
start.waiting: Waiting for the host to start…

sing.watching: You're watching this one. Turn on your mic and get ready to sing the next song.

results.title: Results
results.replayNone: No recordings arrived, so there's no replay.
results.waitingHost: Waiting for the host to pick the next song…

lyrics.title: Lyrics (optional)
lyrics.intro: Give the converter the lyrics and it fits them to the voice instead of guessing the words. Much better for screamed, fast or heavily processed singing.
lyrics.noneFound: No lyrics found. Check the title and artist, or paste the lyrics below.
lyrics.otherVersion: Another version (different length): the timing will be shifted to fit your file.
lyrics.placeholder: Paste the lyrics here, one line per line. Or find them online above.
lyrics.hintTimed: The times in [brackets] say when each line starts. Leave them in: they keep every line in sync.
lyrics.hintPlain: No times: the words will be fitted to the voice in one go. Lyrics with times (found online) work best.
lyrics.hintEmpty: Leave empty to let the converter guess the words.
lyrics.redoIntro: Fit new lyrics to the voice of “{{title}}” and rebuild its chart. This takes a few minutes and doesn't use up a conversion.
lyrics.redoWarning: This replaces the song's chart, including any changes you made in the chart editor.
lyrics.redoConfirm: Replace the chart, including your changes in the editor?
lyrics.busy: This song is being worked on. Wait until it's ready.
lyrics.redoFailed: Redoing the lyrics didn't work, so the previous chart was kept

modes.title: Game mode
modes.sing_togetherHelp: Everyone who is ready sings the same song at once.
modes.spotlightHelp: Spotlight: take turns. Add your own song to the queue; while someone sings, everyone else watches, cheers and votes.

spotlight.queueEmpty: Nobody in the queue yet. Add your turn!
spotlight.waitingFor: Waiting for {{names}} to turn on the mic and press ready.
spotlight.partnerHelp: This is a duet: your partner sings part 2.
spotlight.howPoints: Points: 70% pitch score, 30% audience stars (5 stars = 10,000). Several turns are averaged.
spotlight.rate: How was it? Tap the stars.
spotlight.voted: Thanks! You can still change your vote.
spotlight.noAudience: Everyone sang this one, so there's no audience to vote: pitch score only.

stage.title: Stage screen (TV or laptop)
stage.intro: Open this on a TV or laptop connected to speakers: it plays the music for the whole room and shows the note lanes, lyrics, scores and reactions big. It doesn't take a player's spot. Phones stop playing the music while it's open.
stage.openHere: Open the stage screen on this computer
stage.scan: Or scan this with the TV's or laptop's camera / browser
stage.startHelp: Click once so this screen may play sound.
stage.queueEmpty: Queue's empty: add your turn on your phone!
stage.noSong: The host is picking a song
stage.badLink: This stage link doesn't work any more. Open a new one from the host's room page.
stage.connected: A stage screen is playing the music, so phones stay quiet.
stage.musicHereOn: 🔊 Music on this phone: on (tap to turn off)
stage.musicHereOff: 🔇 Music on this phone: off, the stage plays it (tap for headphones)

voice.afarOff: 🎧 Not in the room? Listen from afar
voice.afarOn_one: 🎧 Listening from afar: {{count}} voice, music {{delay}} s later to match. Tap to stop
voice.afarOn_other: 🎧 Listening from afar: {{count}} voices, music {{delay}} s later to match. Tap to stop
voice.failed: The live voice isn't working (check the network).
voice.stageOff: 🔈 Singer's voice on these speakers: off
voice.stageOn_one: 🔊 Singer's voice on these speakers: on ({{count}}). Off if it echoes
voice.stageOn_other: 🔊 Singers' voices on these speakers: on ({{count}}). Off if it echoes

solo.title: Solo
solo.intro: Pick a song and sing it on your own. Your best score on each song is kept.
solo.signInWhy: to keep your scores and compete in the song of the day.
solo.replay: Listen back: your voice over the music

daily.title: Song of the day
daily.noSong: No song today (the starter library is empty).
daily.unfinished: You started today's song but didn't finish it. Come back tomorrow!
daily.oneShot: You get one try a day: it counts from the moment the song starts.
daily.oneShotWarning: This is your one try for today. Get the mic and delay check right first, then start.
daily.guestPractice: You're playing as a guest: this is practice and won't go on the leaderboard.
daily.practiceNote: Practice run: sign in to get on the leaderboard.
daily.nobodyYet: Nobody has sung it yet today. Be the first!
daily.noRecording: Your recording never arrived, so your try couldn't be checked and isn't on the board.
daily.adjustedNote: Your phone said {{claimed}}; the server listened to your recording and scored it lower.
daily.checksExplained: The top 10 are checked: the server listens to each recording and scores it again. ✓ = checked, ✓* = corrected by the check.

plan.title: Your plan
plan.spotlightNo: Sing Together only (Spotlight needs premium or a Party Pass)
plan.replaysNo: No group replays in your rooms (solo runs still have one)
plan.passHelp: Start one when the party starts: for 24 hours your rooms get premium (16 players, Spotlight, group replays).
plan.replaysNotIncluded: Group replays come with premium or a Party Pass for the host.
plan.lockedInRoom: Free rooms: up to 4 players, Sing Together, no group replay. Premium or a Party Pass unlocks 16 players, Spotlight and replays.
plan.startPassHere_other: Start a Party Pass (24 h, {{count}} left)
plan.getPremium: Have a code? Redeem it in your profile

admin.title: Admin
admin.give: Give premium or a Party Pass

kinds.party_pass: Party Pass (24 h, started by them)

admin.codesHelp: Hand codes out (a gift, a giveaway). Each person can use a code once; a code can be used by several people.
